entities.name: user
entities.summary: User had her first appointment at Pacific Fertility Clinic on Wilshire with Dr. Reyes around March 3rd. Dr. Reyes ordered blood work, which showed an initial AMH of 1.2 ng/mL, later corrected to 1.4 ng/mL, and then retested at 1.1 ng/mL after a lab calibration issue was flagged. User is 34 years old. User is undergoing timed intercourse with letrozole as suggested by Dr. Reyes. User started her first round of letrozole 5mg on cycle day 3 around late March and experienced headaches and joint pain for about four days. User is using the Premom app to track fertility data and the easy@Home OPK strips with 25 mIU sensitivity for ovulation prediction. A day-21 progesterone check came back at 14.2, confirming ovulation for that cycle, but no pregnancy was achieved. User switched from the Ritual prenatal to Thorne Basic Prenatal about three weeks ago due to its methylfolate content. User and her partner, James, decided to skip the current cycle in early May due to his work travel to Denver.
